description: Header file defining template structures for interleaved numeric conversions, including specialized implementations for half and bfloat16 types, using inline PTX assembly for CUDA architectures. It provides conversion routines for data interleaved in registers, handling bias subtraction and format transformations.

classes.name: FastInterleavedAndBiasedNumericArrayConverter
classes.description: Template struct for converting interleaved numeric data with bias correction, specialized for different data types and vector sizes.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs the conversion of interleaved data to a specific format, using inline PTX assembly for CUDA architectures >= 800, handling bias subtraction and format transformation.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Calls convert() method to perform the conversion.
